tests.stimulus: Assert reset at startup and during the SCN_RESET active-line sequence; hold it across clock edges, release, and continue smooth rows for over sixteen edges. Driver changes inputs through the negedge clocking block and samples on rising edges. Random row generation varies with the simulator seed.
tests.expected: After reset and settling, compare continuous center/median output history and all synchronization bits, with reset clearing sync and phase history.
tests.checker: Use the self-contained input-history dvbench_model, with expected wires separate from actual output wires. dpc_sb compares both output ports at negedge plus 0.5 ns, after sixteen reset-release samples. Four-state mismatch raises UVM_ERROR; a comparison count below 100 raises VACUOUS. The model never reads actual output.
